game.name: Falling Skies : Le Jeu Vidéo (Brazil)(En,Fr,Es,Pt)
game.desc: Mixing role-playing and strategy, the adventure will take place in the tense and uncompromising world of the series created by Amblin Television. The survival of the human race is at stake! Players will plunge into a world on the brink of collapse. They will command a squad of survivors recruited from the resistance fighting to save the planet. The team will then engage in operations against the Espheni. They must survive the alien invasion while rescuing humans and recruiting survivors to join the 2nd Division. With effective, strategy-based gameplay, players will be immersed in a unique story featuring all the heroes from the series.
